records.name_string_id_reason: The guide lists multiple locale-table name IDs; see name_string_ids.
title_or_role: Brawler trainer for Stillwater; owner of the haunted graveyard. One of three Brawler start points: "Carlos Brazenfist in Cobblestone Village, Harold at Highroad Junction, or Caitlyn Gravefog at Stillwater Crossing." (296956814). Teaches the job ("Let me teach you the brawler job first", 1220502472).

location_evidence: "Standing next to his kart, around the corner to the north east" (3439454587: "Have you met Francis yet?"). Not seen in video.
